svg.aria-label: Progress: each row moves from authored to measured, and the revision says when

g.text: Progress: each row moves from authored to measured, and the revision says when
TM-NESB-004 is the record of nes-bench#6. A row is MEASURED when a dated log or photo says so, and not before; 'compiles' and 'authored' are what the desk can say on its own.

svg.text: THE PAD, BOTH PATHS
MEASURED
2026-10-13 the sink rule, both report shapes, the pad poll at 3.3 V, USB typing and BLE typing: on the P4 kit, one binary.
COMPILES
2026-10-12 firmware/pad for esp32s3 (USBMode=default); the desk test holds both descriptors to each other, mutant red.
NEXT
a XIAO on the desk: its silkscreen against sheet 2; lsusb 303a:1001 on the native socket before any flash;
flash firmware/pad; a host sees 303a:0002 and gets eight keys; no host: the radio, a phone pairs, SC not legacy.
OPEN
latency, press to key, either path (bench item 11); a case or a lead the XIAO lives in; the mode switch as a real part.
THE CELL AND THE CHARGER
ON THE DESK
2026-10-13 a LiPo 3.7 V 2000 mAh (JST lead) and a strip of
USB-C TP4056 boards with the DW01 protection pair (photos).
DECIDE
option A, the cell on the BAT pads, or B, through a TP4056
board: with a meter, by whether the cell has its own
protection and whether 100 mA is a charge rate to live with.
MEASURE
current in at the socket while charging; current out of
the cell while playing on BLE and on USB; hours per charge;
what the pad does while it charges (the P4 kit cannot say).
OPEN
a battery level for the BLE battery service: a divider to an
ADC pin, or the Plus variant's ADC_BAT on GPIO10.
THE THINGS THE P4 TAUGHT, CARRIED OVER
HOSTED RADIO
the P4's radio is a C6 over SDIO; SC pairing failed at the DHKey
check and the P4 pairs legacy. The S3's radio is on the die, so
SC is expected to work and is what the sketch asks for there.
THE PI
a bonded, trusted Pi reconnects to the pad on its own and holds
it; a phone sees nothing until the Pi is told block. Pairing from
a script needs tools/btpair.py (bluetoothctl's prompt eats pipes).
NO REPORT ID
on the air, ever: BlueZ 5.66 dropped the numbered report. keymap.h
serves both shapes from one body; USB keeps ID 1.
ONE SOCKET
the keyboard takes it; the log moves to D6/D7; flash by hand.
